telemetry.provenance: anonymous first-party CLI telemetry; unauthenticated ingest (self-asserted id); wau/mau are best-effort and forgeable (not a sybil-verified count); engagedMau is a sybil-dampened floor (installs with >=2 active days of real usage); verifiedMau is the sybil-resistant tier (installs whose events are Ed25519-signed by an enrolled telemetry:sensor key), 0 until CLI signing ships; tiers rank verified > engaged > reported

downloads.definition: Gross download events summed across everything the tracker collects (public non-fork repos in opena2a-org, opena2a-standards and ecolibria; npm packages by author ecolibria plus pinned; PyPI packages discovered from those repos plus pinned; Docker images under opena2a/; Hugging Face models by opena2a): npm downloads (daily rows since 2025-01-28), PyPI downloads without mirrors (daily rows since 2026-02-02; pypistats serves 180 days, earlier history unrecoverable), Docker Hub cumulative pulls, Hugging Face all-time downloads, and GitHub git clones (daily counts since 2025-10-24, summed as GitHub reports them, so automated CI, mirror and repeat clones each count) - not deduplicated across days, actors or sources; page views excluded.

pypi.note: pypistats serves 180 days; rows before the first collection are unrecoverable, no backfill exists

downloadsExCrypto.definition: Gross download events summed across everything the tracker collects (public non-fork repos in opena2a-org, opena2a-standards and ecolibria; npm packages by author ecolibria plus pinned; PyPI packages discovered from those repos plus pinned; Docker images under opena2a/; Hugging Face models by opena2a), excluding ecolibria/cryptoserve and the cryptoserve* packages: npm downloads (daily rows since 2025-01-28), PyPI downloads without mirrors (daily rows since 2026-02-02; pypistats serves 180 days, earlier history unrecoverable), Docker Hub cumulative pulls, Hugging Face all-time downloads, and GitHub git clones (daily counts since 2025-10-24, summed as GitHub reports them, so automated CI, mirror and repeat clones each count) - not deduplicated across days, actors or sources; page views excluded.

pypi.note: pypistats serves 180 days; rows before the first collection are unrecoverable, no backfill exists

adoption.definition: Package, image and model download events plus current 14-day distinct cloners: the same gross npm, PyPI, Docker Hub and Hugging Face terms plus GitHub's rolling 14-day distinct-cloner snapshot; a mixed-window sum in which only the clone term is deduplicated, and only within 14 days.

pypi.note: pypistats serves 180 days; rows before the first collection are unrecoverable, no backfill exists
